stages.name: manifest-preflight
commands: derive RUN_ID
prove RUN_ROOT and RECEIPT_ROOT are absent non-symlink paths
create owner-only RECEIPT_ROOT

stages.name: artifact-fetch-and-v105-build
commands: fetch public v1.1.2 artifacts
verify tarball, executable, and SPDX hashes
build v1.0.5 fixture producer from peeled source tag in disposable package directory

stages.name: topology-preflight
commands: prove port 13307 is unbound
prove backup namespace differs from production backup.env
prove unique database, SQL-user, and client-directory mappings

stages.name: create-client-pointers
commands: write literal seven-key pointer for every manifest client
hash canonical pointer bytes
record metadata.json as absent

stages.name: source-fixture-production
commands: produce dense_policy v49 source
produce sparse_closed v49 source
produce rig_wisp v49 source
push each source active branch to its run-scoped local remote

stages.name: capture-v49-baseline
commands: capture-inventory dense_policy source
capture-inventory sparse_closed source
capture-inventory rig_wisp source

stages.name: single-use-backup
commands: sync each source exactly once through isolated backup principal
record object version IDs, ETags, size inventory, branch heads, helper commit, and command digest

stages.name: clean-target-restore-to-migrated
commands: restore dense_policy source backup to clean migrated target with verification
restore sparse_closed source backup to clean migrated target with verification
restore rig_wisp source backup to clean migrated target with verification

stages.name: target-side-remote-materialization
commands: read restored active branch and local head with v1.0.5 client
refuse pre-existing target remote
configure exact run-scoped origin
fetch origin to materialize cached remote ref
capture local and cached migration-row comparison

stages.name: designated-migrator-record
commands: record human or session identity
record process ID, host, candidate executable hash, start time, and ordered target database list
block any second candidate opener until migrator finishes

stages.name: migration-gate-and-single-retry
commands: prove BD_ALLOW_REMOTE_MIGRATE and BD_SMART_GATE are unset
run first bd migrate for each target through WITH_CLIENT
capture stdout, stderr, and exit code
if migrate-or-adopt refusal occurs, prove inventory unchanged and retry once with BD_ALLOW_REMOTE_MIGRATE=1
hard-stop on adopt, fork-skew, unknown classification, or changed bytes after refusal

stages.name: capture-v53-and-golden-schema
commands: capture post-migration inventory for every migrated shape
create same-server v1.1.2 golden schema reference
prove migrated schema hash equals golden schema hash

stages.name: round-trip-commands
commands: create rehearsal parent
create rehearsal child
update child active bug
dep add child parent
comments add child
close child
list parent child
show child with comments

stages.name: restore-v49-baseline-to-restored
commands: restore unchanged dense_policy backup to clean restored target
restore unchanged sparse_closed backup to clean restored target
restore unchanged rig_wisp backup to clean restored target
capture restored target with v1.0.5 client
prove every restored artifact and combined hash equals the v49 baseline

stages.name: immutable-receipts
commands: copy complete receipt set to RECEIPT_ROOT
write top-level SHA256SUMS
prove no secret values were written

stages.name: stop-boundary
commands: stop only the manifest PID whose executable, start time, port, socket, and RUN_ROOT match
retain RECEIPT_ROOT

stages.name: cleanup-after-acceptance
commands: delete only RUN_ID-scoped databases, users, grants, remotes, cached refs, clients, wrappers, probe closure, and backup namespace
prove port 13307 absent and production port 3307 unchanged from pre-run observation
prove production tenant registry and backup configuration digests unchanged
prove involved checkouts clean
